depth.failed: Couldn't load the BOM's structure and alternates: the lines show without them.

hold.noManage: Your role reads this BOM; changing it needs the BOM edit right.
hold.loading: Wait until the BOM's structure is read.
hold.archived: The style is archived: reactivate it to change its BOM.
hold.frozen: This revision is not a draft: start a new revision to change it.
hold.offline: Offline — nothing is sent until the connection is back.
hold.busy: Wait for the change being saved.

mark.refused: Not saved: the stored value stays (the notice says why).

done.option: The line is now only for that option.
done.optionOff: The line is for every garment again.
done.alternateAdded: Alternate added after the last one.
done.alternateRemoved: Alternate removed: the ones after it moved up.

lines.removeGroupHeld: Lines are grouped under it: ungroup them first.

needs.none: Used like the line's own material
needs.ONLY_WHEN_SHORT: only when the line's own material is short
needs.NEEDS_APPROVAL: each use needs a person's approval

alt.intro: Used in this order when {code} cannot be: the first is tried first.
alt.empty: No alternates: only the line's own material is used.
alt.label: Alternate {priority}: {code}
alt.qtyHint: Per garment, in the line's unit; empty: the line's own ({qty}).
alt.qtyBad: Type a number above 0 (1,9 or 1.9), or leave it empty.
alt.certificateHint: Switch it on when the notified body may have to agree to the change.
alt.certificateRequired: A PPE component is involved: the check stays on.
alt.notCovered: No certificate in the register covers it: the notified body may have to agree.
alt.removeBody: The alternates after it move up one place. The line's own material stays.
alt.searchHint: Search the materials library; it goes after the last alternate, with approval needed until you change it.

held.sub: A sub-assembly line takes no alternates: its sub-assembly is made here.
held.max: This line has the most alternates a line may have (10).

supply.workshopCut: Goes to the workshop cut, as bundles

bulk.sectionHint: The section the BOM shows them under; from their material, each line goes back to its kind's section.
bulk.groupHint: Under a line of this BOM (a kit, a pocket, an insert); Not grouped takes them out of their group.
bulk.supplyTitle_one: Who sends {count} line, and the workshop
bulk.supplyTitle_other: Who sends {count} lines, and the workshop

who.customer: A customer sends them (no cost, no purchase)

workshop.yes: They go in the workshop's kit

bulk.supplyChoose: Choose the customer that sends them.
bulk.supplyBlocked: A customer cannot send {lines}: a line bought from a supplier, or a sub-assembly we make.

findings.titleWarnings_one: {count} thing to look at (the release can go ahead)
findings.titleWarnings_other: {count} things to look at (the release can go ahead)
findings.intro: Live: Show me lands on the cell to fix.
findings.MATERIAL_BLOCKED: Line {line}: the material {material} is blocked (refused for use). Choose another material.
findings.ALTERNATE_BLOCKED: Line {line}: the alternate {alternate} is blocked. Remove it or choose another.
findings.SUB_ASSEMBLY_NOT_RELEASED: Line {line}: the sub-assembly {sub} is not released. Release it, or take its released revision.
findings.SUB_ASSEMBLY_NOT_MADE: Line {line}: {material} is no longer a component we make in pieces, pairs or sets (or a customer sends it). Change the line or take the sub-assembly off.
findings.SUB_ASSEMBLY_CIRCLE: Line {line}: the sub-assembly {sub} contains this style again (a circle). Take another sub-assembly.
findings.SUB_ASSEMBLY_TOO_DEEP: Line {line}: the sub-assemblies go deeper than 10 levels.
findings.SUB_ASSEMBLY_UNIT: Line {line}: its unit does not count what the sub-assembly {sub} makes.
findings.SUB_ASSEMBLY_SIZE_MISSING: Line {line}: the sub-assembly {sub} has no size for size {size}.
findings.SUB_ASSEMBLY_COLOURWAY_MISSING: Line {line}: the sub-assembly {sub} has no colourway for a colourway that uses the line.
findings.GROUP_CIRCLE: Line {line}: grouped under a line that is grouped under it (a circle). Ungroup one of them.
findings.PPE_MATERIAL_NOT_APPROVED: Line {line}: {material} is used for protection and is not approved yet.
findings.ALTERNATE_ARCHIVED: Line {line}: the alternate {alternate} is archived: it is never taken.
findings.SUB_ASSEMBLY_STYLE_ARCHIVED: Line {line}: the style of the sub-assembly {sub} is archived.

keyHint.views: Next view (Lines, By size, By colourway, Tree)
keyHint.move: Move the line up or down (Alt+↑ / Alt+↓)

line.title: Line {line}
line.loading: Reading the line's structure and alternates…
line.w1Fields: Material, quantity, wastage, colours and the operation are in Edit (⋯ on the line).
line.sectionKindHint: Shown under its material's section ({kind}) until you file it.
line.groupHint: A line of this BOM it belongs to (a kit, a pocket, an insert).

sub.title: Sub-assembly
sub.searchHint: Another style's BOM that line {line} takes (a removable liner, an armour insert).
sub.revisionHint: Released first; a draft stops this BOM's release until it is released.
sub.noRevision: That style has no revision yet.

held.notComponent: Line {line} takes a bought material: a sub-assembly line takes the component we make. Choose that component as the line's material first.
held.unit: Line {line} is not counted in pieces, pairs or sets: change its unit first.
held.customer: A customer sends line {line}: a sub-assembly is one we make.

supply.title: Who sends it
supply.searchHint: A customer or a brand: the line then has no cost and is not bought.
supply.searchFailed: Couldn't search the customers (your role may not read them).

held.supplier: The line is bought from a named supplier: clear its supplier (Edit) first.
held.sub: The line is a sub-assembly we make: the customer does not send it.

line.workshopHint: When a job is sent to a workshop, the marked lines make its kit.
line.workshopKit: It goes in the workshop's kit.
line.workshopCut: Leather tracked by the hide: it goes cut, as bundles.

option.title: Only for an option
option.hint: A line only for one option is taken only when that option is chosen.
option.none: The style offers no options yet.

sizes.fillOne: Fill line {line} from the base size
sizes.offline_one: Offline: {count} size waits on this page and is sent when the connection is back.
sizes.offline_other: Offline: {count} sizes wait on this page and are sent when the connection is back.
sizes.hint: Type or paste a quantity (6,35 or 6.35); a cell saves by itself; Fill… sets every size from the base by a step.
sizes.hintRead: Quantities per garment, in the line's unit.

fill.title: Fill line {line} from the base size
fill.intro: Each size = the base size's quantity + its steps from the base × the increment, in {unit}. Sizes typed by hand stay.

empty.title: No sub-assemblies
empty.body: A component we make (a liner, an armour insert) can take another style's revision: open its line and choose the sub-assembly.

usedIn.title: Used as a sub-assembly in
usedIn.intro: The revisions of other styles that take {code} as a sub-assembly.
usedIn.failed: Couldn't read where it is used.
usedIn.none: No other style takes it as a sub-assembly.

grades.none: No pattern pieces are cut from this line yet.
grades.rule: Cutting refuses a hide below a piece's minimum grade.
